failure: image_event_indices points to an event after the image endpoint
impact: The first four outputs used the legacy off-by-one endpoint offsets and are preserved but excluded from the corrected all-sequence manifest. No model scoring was performed.

pinned_evreal_source.verified_contract: bag_to_npy stores searchsorted(events_ts,images_ts,right)-1, but MemMapDataset slices event arrays as [idx0:idx1) and treats stored index as end offset

recommended_fix: Use searchsorted(events_ts,image_ts,right) as an end-exclusive offset for EVREAL slices, retain exact (previous,current] windows, and independently verify included/following event timestamp bounds.
root_cause: The timestamp index is an end-exclusive EVREAL event offset, but the adapter validation indexed events_ts[offset] as though offset identified the included last event. For the first reference image before the first event, the valid exclusive offset is zero and the first event is not included; the validator falsely treated that excluded event as a future event. Review of pinned EVREAL source also found bag_to_npy stores searchsorted(right)-1 while MemMapDataset slices [previous_offset,current_offset), dropping the event at each endpoint.
